news.body:
## Thursday evening cleared both open items
- The Career Anchor scores are in, four days before Liesbeth's cutoff.
Nice work. That was the one with a real consequence behind it, since missing Monday costs the session rather than just the task.
- Your mail to the fees thread went out the same evening, and nothing has come back.
Tuesday is the instalment date and a transfer that size takes a few days to show on INSEAD's side. Marie Rose answers on WhatsApp and keeps a Calendly open, so if Monday is quiet that is faster than a second mail on a thread she has told you is busy.
## The weekend is the first clear one you have had
- x360 is still waiting on names.
LearningBridge confirmed your self-assessment on the 16th and said no observers are listed. Your providers then need until 28 December, so the naming is the only part of this with a clock on it, and it takes ten minutes.
